phases.name: Coordinator + Basic Supervision
phases.summary: Implement Coordinator facade, supervised sessions, AgentRunRegistry, and AgentRunTaskSupervisor. Route WorkspaceLive agent sends through Coordinator.
notes: WorkspaceLive no longer starts agent runs directly; sends route through Sigil.Agent.Coordinator.add_message/3.
Session.start_or_get/1 now starts sessions through Sigil.SessionSupervisor while preserving the {:already_started, pid} path.
Background agent and title-generation tasks run under Sigil.AgentRunTaskSupervisor.
Follow-up phases 2-5 are now completed and tracked in this status file.

phases.name: Runner GenServer
phases.summary: Add Runner status/cancel ownership and async_nolink task handling.
notes: Added Sigil.Agent.Runner as the run state owner.
Runner uses Task.Supervisor.async_nolink/2 for Sigil.Agent.run/2 execution.
Coordinator.status/1 and cancel/1 now route through Runner when an active runner exists.
Task crash broadcasts run_end status: error and leaves Session idle.

phases.name: Per-run Supervisor + Queue Ownership
phases.summary: Move CandidateQueue ownership to run supervision tree.
notes: Added Sigil.AgentRunSupervisor DynamicSupervisor and per-run Sigil.Agent.RunSupervisor.
RunSupervisor starts CandidateQueue before Runner with a one_for_all strategy.
Sigil.Agent.run/2 accepts an external candidate_queue and no longer creates a queue when Runner supplies one.
Cancel seals the queue; stale queue enqueue returns {:error, :sealed}; same conversation rejects concurrent start_run/3.

phases.name: EventRecorder
phases.summary: Record important session events to jsonl with secret filtering and delta throttling.
notes: Added Sigil.EventRecorder JSONL writer.
Records run_start, tool_start, tool_end, run_end, and error events.
Skips high-frequency message_delta events.
Applies Sigil.Log.Redactor before writing jsonl.
Session.broadcast_event/3 integration records important events when enabled.

phases.name: SessionStore
phases.summary: Add SessionStore behaviour and file-backed runtime snapshot persistence.
notes: Added Sigil.SessionStore behaviour and Sigil.SessionStore.File implementation.
Session snapshots save seq, events, running?, model, and next_turn_messages.
File store scrubs pid/task/ref/port runtime values before writing.
Session load restores recoverable snapshot data and never restores pid/task/queue.
Session restart integration restores snapshot and next_turn_messages from file store when enabled.
